description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hambantota, Hambantota D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830114
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels in Hambantota, including detailed schedules listing parcel numbers, extents, owners, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within land and property-related matters as defined for Type 4 classification, with no government personnel changes or structural administrative matters present.
